row.evidence: ProfitWell Metrics is "completely free" with unlimited users added by e-mail invite ("Enter e-mail address of team member and click 'send invite'"); no SSO or SCIM is documented anywhere in Paddle's ProfitWell help centre.
row.notes: New row. ProfitWell was acquired by Paddle and is now sold as ProfitWell Metrics, a free subscription-analytics product; profitwell.com redirects to paddle.com. Users are invited by e-mail with User or Admin permissions; for Paddle sellers, Metrics access follows the Paddle team-member role (Admin, Technical, Subscription KPIs) and removal also needs a support request. No SAML/OIDC SSO, SCIM or team-member API is documented; the ProfitWell API covers customer (subscriber) data only. Retain, the paid add-on product, is flat-fee from $500/month or performance-based. Not in the Okta OIN or Entra gallery. None by absence (rule 5).

plans.name: ProfitWell Metrics
plans.notes: Unlimited users. Retain (dunning/churn recovery) is a separate paid product: flat fee from $500/month for smaller companies, performance-based for larger ones.

scim.notes: No SCIM, SAML or SSO page in the Paddle sitemap (1,274 URLs, incl. the ProfitWell Metrics help section) or the ProfitWell help articles on users and login; team members are invited by email. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

user_api.notes: The ProfitWell API covers subscriber/customer data (Customers API, data input) only; no endpoints for ProfitWell team members. False is by absence.

entra.notes: No ProfitWell entry in the Entra SaaS app tutorial index (toc.json); profitwell-tutorial returns 404.

fallbacks.other_sync: For Paddle sellers, Metrics access follows Paddle team-member roles (Admin, Technical, Subscription KPIs).
